title: 8.1.2 Lab: Your First Box
description: Add your first box in reSHape and set its size in the Dimensions panel. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Add a box
steps.instructions: Press the Box tool in the toolbar (the cube icon). A box appears in the 3D view right away, and its numbers show in the Dimensions panel.
hints: The Box tool's tooltip reads "Add a box" when you hover it.
The box is placed at the center as soon as you press the tool - you do not need to click in the 3D view.

steps.title: Set its size in the Dimensions panel
steps.instructions: With the box selected, look at the Dimensions panel on the right. Type 40 in width, 40 in depth, and 30 in height.
hints: Width and depth already read 40 — that's fine, those are the numbers you want. Height reads 20; type 30 to change it.
Each field has a slider above it and a number box below it. Click the number box and type to change it exactly.
Click inside the height field before typing. Pressing Enter with the Box button still highlighted adds a second box, and the Quest will say it found a box 91.5 wide.

steps.title: Check and submit
steps.instructions: Open the Quest tab to see whether your box meets the requirement, then press Submit.
hints: The Quest tab shows a checklist. A green check means that requirement is met.

requirements.title: A 40 x 40 x 30 mm box
requirements.description: The part is a single box, 40 mm wide, 40 mm deep, and 30 mm tall.
requirements.hint: Press the Box tool, then check that width, depth, and height read 40, 40, 30 in the Dimensions panel.
